en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a two-story building with a tiled roof, classical columns, and a covered balcony on the upper floor. A single person dressed in early 20th-century attire is visible in the foreground, walking across a dirt area. The image has an old-fashioned feel, and the structure appears to be significant, possibly a historic or royal building.
